verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's order and readable sizes, but the orange headline is pushed far right and no longer lines up with the centred column under it. It is also a narrow centred stack in a wide banner, so the sides are dead space and the bottom text sits tight to the bottom edge. B scatters the copy into arbitrary spots: the headline is top-left, a dash rule floats alone and the body text is stranded bottom-left. The divider is broken into two uneven dash rows jammed beside the teal line, the booking/contact text is shrunk until you can't read it, and big empty patches make it look unplanned.
